entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker and archmage who escapes the Shard of the Twelve Worlds to Shandalar and is destroyed by an Astral dragon's flood of mana.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane incredibly rich in mana, where wizards must rely on their brains and where planeswalkers come to conquer.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: An emaciated planeswalker who watches Faralyn die and vows to defeat Kenan Sahrmal and conquer Shandalar.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A demonic planeswalker from Dominaria who arrives on Shandalar and fights Bani Bakur and Sahrmal.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who plots against Sahrmal and tricks the duel sisters by posing as the crone Magus.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: The legendary protector of Shandalar, absent for twelve years, who watches from hiding and is eventually beheaded by Bani after Lim-Dûl swaps bodies with him.

entities.name: Bani Bakur
entities.description: A dark-haired duel sister devoted to Sahrmal who vows revenge on the planeswalkers after her sister's death.

entities.name: Ravash Mog
entities.description: Bani's red-haired duel sister, killed when Lim-Dûl exploits her fear of paralysis.

entities.name: Anthanor
entities.description: A soldier of Bani's forces devoured by Szat's Essence Vortex.

entities.name: Astral dragon
entities.description: A creature of pure mana, sent by Sahrmal, who overwhelms Faralyn with mana until he explodes.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: The rune-warded, burnished-towered city founded by Sahrmal.

entities.name: Shadowwood
entities.description: A forest of Shandalar where dark elves face human zombies for the first time.

entities.name: Catacombs of Shandalar
entities.description: The catacombs where Sahrmal is said to listen to prayers and where Lim-Dûl appears as Magus.

entities.name: El-Aman
entities.description: A desert region of Shandalar where Leshrac and the planeswalkers gather.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: The prison from which Faralyn escapes.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane from which Szat and Lim-Dûl came and where Lim-Dûl keeps his artifacts.

entities.name: Dark elves of the Shadowwood
entities.description: Forest elves rescued from zombies by the duel sisters.

entities.name: Knights of Kjeldor
entities.description: Dominarian knights on whom Lim-Dûl plans revenge.

entities.name: Tymolin
entities.description: Someone whose death Szat blames on himself.

entities.name: Book of Rings
entities.description: Sahrmal's book chronicling worlds, which Bani invokes as his guide.

entities.name: Jester's Cap
entities.description: An artifact Magus wields to discover the sisters' weaknesses.

events.summary: Faralyn arrives on Shandalar from the Shard, mocks Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl, and claims the plane for himself.
events.quote: He mocks them for trying to betray him and claims Shandalar for his own.

events.summary: An Astral dragon feeds Faralyn mana until he can bear no more and explodes in a rainbow of colors.
events.quote: It fills Faralyn with mana until the wizards can't take it anymore and explodes in a rainbow of colors.

events.summary: Leshrac, watching Faralyn's end, wards himself against other planeswalkers and vows to defeat Sahrmal and conquer Shandalar.
events.quote: He vows to defeat Kenan Sahrmal and conquer Shandalar for his own.

events.summary: Bani Bakur and Ravash Mog arrive on flying seahorses and save the Shadowwood dark elves from human zombies.
events.quote: The duel sisters Bani Bakur and Ravash Mog arrive on flying seahorses and smite the zombies with their enchanted weapons.

events.summary: In Ardestan Bani senses alien corruption in the mana currents while Ravash demands Sahrmal return, though he has been absent for twelve years.
events.quote: Bani says that he has been absent for twelve years

events.summary: Tevesh Szat and Lim-Dûl arrive; Lim-Dûl is entombed in stone, and Leshrac burns him in a fire spell, causing Szat to flee.
events.quote: Leshrac conjures an immense fire spell and seemingly obliterates the necromancer.

events.summary: The real Lim-Dûl, who was only a mana manifestation when burned, appears in the Catacombs and poses as the crone Magus to the duel sisters, who believe she is Sahrmal.
events.quote: As Baki and Ravash enter the Catacombs, they meet Magus and are led to believe that it is Kenan Sahrmal in disguise.

events.summary: Szat reflects on Dominaria and his sister, blaming himself for Tymolin's death.
events.quote: all pleasure perished when he let Tymolin die

events.summary: Magus sends bats; Bani is crippled by fear and Lim-Dûl casts Mind Whip on Ravash, who falls to her death. Bani vows to kill Szat.
events.quote: Ravash slips on the edge of a precipice and falls to her death.

events.summary: Sahrmal watches Lim-Dûl from the back of the catacombs, stung by Bani's words about his inaction.
events.quote: Unbeknownst to the necromancer, he is watched by Sarmahl himself from the back of the catacombs.

events.summary: Bani and her allies fight Tevesh Szat, now calling himself World-Ender, in the desert while Sahrmal watches in astral form.
Lim-Dûl plots to trick Sahrmal into attacking the planeswalkers, creates Manabarbs against Szat; Sahrmal joins with Fire Sprites, Szat devours Anthanor and casts Winter's Chill.
events.quote: The spell completely devours the soldier.

events.summary: Sahrmal reveals his mortal form and protects Bani, but Szat stuns him with Infernal Darkness.
events.quote: This is the moment that Sahrmal unveils his mortal form.

events.summary: Leshrac returns and tells Szat that Lim-Dûl is sapping him with manabarbs; the bickering planeswalkers retreat as Sahrmal casts Whimsy.
events.quote: Disgusted and frustrated with Shandalar's bizarre mana, Szat and Leshrac make a hasty retreat.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl swaps bodies with Sahrmal using Mirror Universe, and Bani beheads Sahrmal's body while Lim-Dûl's essence in Sahrmal's body fades away.
events.quote: enough to allow Bani to slice off his head

events.summary: Bani rejects Lim-Dûl's attempt to pose as Sahrmal; Lim-Dûl spends twelve years massing undead legions before attacking Ardestan.
events.quote: Then his attack on Ardestan begins.
